page_title: ALM 2-3 CEL | Almeria v Celta Vigo 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+8' A wild effort from Dion Lopy (Almeria) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
90+6' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+6' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Almeria.
90+3' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Bamba will be replaced by Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo).
90+2' Substitution. Luis Suarez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leo Baptistao (Almeria).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Rafael Benitez has decided to substitute Iago Aspas and he is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
89' Substitution. Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) replaces Carlos Dominguez.
88' The substitution has been made. Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) has replaced Marc Pubill.

87' 2 - 3 Goal! Manu Sanchez plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 2:3.
85' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Iago Aspas, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
83' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
79' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
78' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
76' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

75' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Luis Maximiano guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.

74' Nice individual effort by Ibrahima Kone (Almeria). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Ivan Villar does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
73' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
70' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen walks off the pitch and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
68' 2 - 2 Goal Sergio Arribas (Almeria)! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) was put through by Largie Ramazani and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 2:2.
67' Here is a change. Gonzalo Melero is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
67' Here's the change. Iddrisu Baba Mohammed leaves the pitch and Dion Lopy (Almeria) comes on as a substitute.
66' The corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Luis Maximiano.

66' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

64' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Ivan Villar didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
61' Luis Suarez (Almeria) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Ivan Villar pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
58' Marc Pubill (Almeria) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
56' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

54' 1 - 2 Sergio Akieme (Almeria) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Gonzalo Melero, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
53' Luis Suarez (Almeria) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
50' Wonderful pass from Largie Ramazani (Almeria) for Gonzalo Melero, but they can't profit from it as Ivan Villar comes off his line to collect.
49' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kaiky (Almeria) and blew his whistle.
48' Almeria couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Ivan Villar (Celta Vigo) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
48' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Almeria have a free kick.
46' Adrian Embarba will be replaced by Ibrahima Kone (Almeria).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Kaiky (Almeria) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45+1' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed plays a lovely pass into Largie Ramazani (Almeria), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Luis Maximiano anticipates well and smothers the ball.
41' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
41' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
40' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marc Pubill.
39' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

38' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Villar pulls off a comfortable save.
37' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. That's a free kick to Celta Vigo.
33' 0 - 2 Goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
33' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea sees the trip by Adrian Embarba (Almeria) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
30' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Manu Sanchez.
28' Marc Pubill (Almeria) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
26' Luis Suarez (Almeria) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
26' The corner from Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is cleared away by the defence.

24' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Iago Aspas flights the free kick into the box, where Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:1.
23' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.
23' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
22' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
21' Luis Suarez (Almeria) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
17' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul. Almeria have been awarded a free kick.
15' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Villar intercepts the ball.
12' Celta Vigo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

11' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
8' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Ivan Villar makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

5' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Almeria in a dangerous position.
3' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
2' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea is the one to supervise the game today.
